definitions.gloss: man-made disaster; calamity caused by human action or negligence
definitions.explanation: A disaster brought about by human error, negligence, or poor planning, as opposed to a purely natural one. Often used to argue that damage blamed on nature was in fact preventable.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{人災|じんさい}だ。
examples.english: This is not a natural disaster but a man-made one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人災|じんさい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cause of the accident was judged to be human error.

examples.japanese: ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}れば→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{人災|じんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧うる。
examples.english: If precautions are neglected, even damage from nature can turn into a man-made disaster.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (human) plus {災|さい} (disaster). The direct counterpart of ⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧ (natural disaster), and frequently paired with it to stress that a calamity was avoidable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人災|じんさい}だ: it is a man-made disaster
- ⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧な{人災|じんさい}: a clear case of human error
- {人災|じんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧: the man-made aspect (of a disaster)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧: natural disaster — the opposite; caused by nature
- ⟦{人為的|じんいてき}→人為的：11661_jiniteki⟧: man-made, artificial — adjective describing a human cause
